Sandwich: 2 slices of bread (about 60 g), plus cheese and ham (about 40 g) and some butter, so roughly 110 g and 300 kcal.

Sushi: 5 pieces at about 30 g each is 150 g, at roughly 1.4 kcal/g, so about 210 kcal.

Total: about 260 g and 510 kcal.
